edits.old: FROM f FULL OUTER JOIN e ON f.account_id=e.account_id AND f.app_id=e.app_id
edits.new: FROM (SELECT coalesce(f.account_id,urm.account_id) account_id,f.* EXCLUDE(account_id) FROM f FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT account_id,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) total_users,avg(count_active_days) avg_active_days_per_user,avg(sum_events) avg_lifetime_events,count(*) FILTER(WHERE count_active_days>=20)::FLOAT/count(DISTINCT visitor_id) highly_active_user_rate FROM (SELECT account_id,visitor_id,count(DISTINCT CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) count_active_days,sum(num_events) sum_events,max(CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) last_event_on FROM staging.stg_pendo__event GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY 1) urm ON f.account_id=urm.account_id) f FULL OUTER JOIN e ON f.account_id=e.account_id AND f.app_id=e.app_id

(SELECT rr.avg_active_days_per_user FROM (SELECT account_id,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) total_users,avg(count_active_days) avg_active_days_per_user,avg(sum_events) avg_lifetime_events,count(*) FILTER(WHERE count_active_days>=20)::FLOAT/count(DISTINCT visitor_id) highly_active_user_rate FROM (SELECT account_id,visitor_id,count(DISTINCT CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) count_active_days,sum(num_events) sum_events,max(CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) last_event_on FROM staging.stg_pendo__event GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY 1) rr WHERE rr.account_id=f.account_id) avg_active_days_per_user

(SELECT rr.avg_lifetime_events FROM (SELECT account_id,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) total_users,avg(count_active_days) avg_active_days_per_user,avg(sum_events) avg_lifetime_events,count(*) FILTER(WHERE count_active_days>=20)::FLOAT/count(DISTINCT visitor_id) highly_active_user_rate FROM (SELECT account_id,visitor_id,count(DISTINCT CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) count_active_days,sum(num_events) sum_events,max(CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) last_event_on FROM staging.stg_pendo__event GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY 1) rr WHERE rr.account_id=f.account_id) avg_lifetime_events

(SELECT rr.highly_active_user_rate FROM (SELECT account_id,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) total_users,avg(count_active_days) avg_active_days_per_user,avg(sum_events) avg_lifetime_events,count(*) FILTER(WHERE count_active_days>=20)::FLOAT/count(DISTINCT visitor_id) highly_active_user_rate FROM (SELECT account_id,visitor_id,count(DISTINCT CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) count_active_days,sum(num_events) sum_events,max(CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) last_event_on FROM staging.stg_pendo__event GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY 1) rr WHERE rr.account_id=f.account_id) highly_active_user_rate

(SELECT count(DISTINCT feature_id) FILTER(WHERE num_events>=10)::FLOAT/nullif(count(DISTINCT feature_id),0) FROM staging.stg_pendo__feature_event ff WHERE ff.account_id=f.account_id AND ff.app_id=f.app_id) feature_depth_adoption_rate
